bootstrap: The trusted owning page creates a module Worker, transfers distinct ownerPort and agentPort MessagePorts exactly once using {op:attach,ownerPort,agentPort}, and retains the owner port.
lifecycle: Lock, revoke and TTL expiry discard key handles and emit sessionEnded metadata to both ports. The trusted controller must clear its plaintext views and terminate the Worker; forensic memory erasure is not promised.
onlineAuthorization: The Worker has no network and cannot independently discover token/connection revocation. The trusted controller must fetch through current Hub OAuth checks and lock on 401/403 or current-fence failures. Already delivered ciphertext/keys/plaintext cannot be remotely recalled; cached offline data is not fresh online authorization.
trust: Root/checkpoint and selected delivery pins are supplied through an independently trusted owner handoff, never auto-confirmed from the same backend response or manifest. A release hash authenticates bytes only relative to a trusted release source.
nextStage: The checked foreground controller, closed same-browser owner bridge and durable ciphertext outbox are implemented as a code stage. Remote Muse host attachment and real consumer/production acceptance remain separate existing work; same-browser MessageChannels do not establish a remote connection.

runAllocation.encoding: prefix run_/manifest_/result_ plus FULL64 lowercase SHA-256 hex of RFC8785 JCS [label,...namespace]. Allocation is pinned locally before POST, never copied from the response.

runOperations: beginRun requires every confirmed preparation object to have passed typed decryption; it caches exact signed Begin bytes per operation. installRun verifies independently allocated IDs, immutable manifest, original intent and issuance author proofs. decryptRun accepts task then resources in formal grant order, with exact last-page retry. Carrier AAD stays its original task/source context; Run binding is transitive through signed Begin and manifest fingerprint references.
runInputPolicy: Run-only private checks retain policy and source facts in memory, cleared on lock. Begin evaluates allowPartial, allowUnknownAsOf and maxFetchedAgeSeconds at trusted client time; frozen Run inputs evaluate those facts at Run.createdAt selection time, while current authorization and Run expiry still use current time. Future fetchedAt, excessive age and stale freshness fail; unknown freshness needs allowUnknownAsOf. Missing sourceAsOf is never replaced with fetchedAt. These are conservative owner-attested input checks, not proof of broker truth or financial freshness.
resultOperations: sealResult requires every frozen Run input to have passed typed decryption and private input policy. It creates revision 1 to exactly the signed grant owner device/recovery recipients. reviseResult requires a locally accepted receipt at expectedRevision. The worker fixes resultId, original task carrier and manifest fingerprint, all Run/grant bindings, current registry and author; callers cannot supply keys/recipients/context. Output is {contractVersion,runId,resultId,revision,expectedRevision,stableOperationId,envelopeFingerprint,envelope:{contractVersion,signedObject}}; POST envelope to /agent/v2/runs/{runId}/results or its signedObject plus contractVersion/expectedRevision to /agent/v2/results/{resultId}/revisions with matching Idempotency-Key. Safe HTTPS citations, conservative Markdown and exact declared outputSpec section ordering are checked privately. These are input guards, not a renderer or proof of analysis/citation truth.
resultOutbox: resultOutbox returns the original exact ciphertext/signature packet plus saved receipt or null, without new encryption. Same Run/operation/content returns original bytes; changing private content under the same operation conflicts. A second initial operation is rejected because the operation ID is authenticated AAD. Up to 32 cached result operations total and two revision candidates per Run/base. Trusted controllers may persist only the returned ciphertext packet for durable retry; this Worker has no persistence and loses its cache on lock/reload. Never silently reencrypt after uncertain outcomes or switch operation IDs.
receiptAcceptance: Only the trusted ownerPort controller may call acceptReceipt after independently fetching the receipt over authenticated current Hub transport; the model/agentPort cannot acknowledge storage. The Worker checks the closed formal ResultReceipt against original outbox context/fingerprint, IDs, operation, revision, deliveryRevision, internal key-free path and nonpredating receivedAt, then advances local revision CAS. A byte-identical prior accepted receipt may be repeated. Receipt acceptance and original outbox retrieval do not require a still-live Run or new cryptographic write authority; the live memory session/pins must still exist. This local check is not a server signature, proof of model execution, successful user decryption or durable storage. Lock/revoke/TTL discards keys, private output rules and outbox handles; saved backend receipt recovery remains available through its own narrowly authorized API.

controller.sameBrowserOnly: Owner window pairing requires the exact configured origin, the actual peer WindowProxy, a one-use 32-byte nonce and one transferred MessagePort. Paired helper DOM exposes no manual owner controls; opener is severed after attachment. This is not a remote Muse transport.
controller.lifecycle: Paired owner heartbeats extend a 90-second owner-presence lease, never the original Worker TTL. Manual public-card mode has no observable remote owner window and relies on bounded Worker TTL, page close/explicit lock and current authenticated host fences. Hidden helper pages pause model operations and hide private views; public owner setup/status may continue.
controller.credentials: Transient consent RPC uses a fresh raw Firebase ID token only for the exact same-origin closed owner request. It never reaches helper/model ports, URLs, DOM or storage. The programmable controller can accept a host-provided opaque OAuth access token in memory; model/public UI has no token operation/input. Same-identity idle host access-token renewal does not extend key TTL or change scopes.
controller.durableOutbox: IndexedDB contains only closed ciphertext packet, approved public scope, immutable run creation time and exact server receipt. CAS preserves original bytes across tabs and lock/reload. Recovery cannot restore private keys or grant a new revision session. No report text, tokens, private JWKs or Passkey data are persisted.
controller.receiptTrust: The controller accepts receipts only from its fixed authenticated host HTTP transport; model-pasted receipt JSON is not an owner capability. Manual public-card page does not claim server storage or enable revisions until a trusted authenticated host provides this integration.
controller.testModel: Pinned fake-indexeddb dev dependency is bundled only under tests/fixtures for mandatory offline transaction tests. It is not a public helper asset or part of the container image. Real WebCrypto tests and simulated browser/Window facades are distinct from physical-browser or Muse acceptance.
